meta.name: Garden Village + Commons
meta.coordinate_system: origin at NW corner, x east, y south, meters
meta.notes: Static world structure only. No agents, schedules, or events.
changes: 0.5: canopy walk and sky bridges at 17.5 m (level-5 roof) with five landing towers; mobility hub filed under farm_west; creek boardwalk bends around the swim pond; edge lanes widened from 5 to 6 m

aesthetic.style: Solarpunk organic-futurist: mass timber, rammed earth, and glass solar skin, softened by plants everywhere
materials: rammed earth base walls in ochre and rose
copper and brass trim that patinas green
signature_features: Canopy walk: a continuous rooftop path at level 5 linking every block with sky bridges, rooftop greenhouses, and hammock decks
Living facades: vertical gardens and climbing jasmine on every south wall
Kinetic shading: bamboo louvers that track the sun and cast moving patterns on the lanes
Lantern lighting: warm low-glare path lights at knee height, dark sky above so the stars stay visible
Rotating murals: each block wall gets a new mural every season by an artist-in-residence
Water everywhere you can hear it: runnels in the lanes feed the creek
aesthetic.fashion_culture: Handmade and mended clothing is high status. Natural dyes from the dye garden, visible mending, bold color, lots of layering and accessories. People dress up for Lantern Market.

lanes.surface: permeable stone, moss joints, water runnels
lanes.notes: All gaps between cells. Bikes slow, walkers priority.

paths.notes: Ring around the green, joins the full 1.6 mi loop at the parkway and creek. Outdoor gym stations at each corner.
Continuous rooftop ring with sky bridges over each lane. Elevators at every block.
